title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy — DOM XSS in document.write sink using source location.search

expected_chain.rationale: GET the lab URL to discover the vulnerable script
send the payload via curl to ?search=<svg/onload=alert(1)>

notes: PortSwigger DOM-XSS introductory lab — the vulnerable line is `document.write(...)` consuming `location.search`. Solver: GET ?search=<svg/onload=alert(1)>. The lab marks itself solved when its tracker JS sees the alert fire; here we just need the markup to land in the response.
